1.
Parties.The parties to this Amended and Restated Cooperative Agreement (Agreement)
are the Wyoming Department of Transportation(WYDOT), whose addressis5300Bishop
Boulevard, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82009, and the City of Cheyenne (City), whose address
is 2101O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001.
2.
Purposeof Agreement.The purpose of this Agreement is to amend andrestate the original
Agreement between WYDOT and the City dated September 22,2023(the Original
Agreement)inits entirety and to setforth the terms and conditions bywhich the parties
will participate in the federally funded Surface Transportation On-System Enhancements
Program, which includes the installation of stamped and colored concrete in the median on
US30 between Pershing Boulevard and Whitney Road, removal of portions ofthe existing
Greenway and associated features, installation of new Greenway path, installation of
lighting at the intersection of US 30 and Christensen Road, realignment the south leg of
the intersection of US 30 and Whitney Road, and the construction ofa pedestrian underpass
and associated elements (Project) at thelocation shown on Exhibit A-1, Revised Location
Map, which is attached to and incorporated into this Agreement by this reference. This
projectis associated withWYDOT main project N561041.
The original Agreement dated September 22, 2023, set forth the terms and conditions by
whichWYDOT and the City will install stamped and colored concrete in the median on
US 30 between Pershing Boulevard and Whitney Road, remove portions of the existing
greenway and associated features, install new Greenway path, install lighting at the
intersection of US 30 and Christensen Road, and realign the south leg of the intersection
of US 30 and Whitney Road (Project)for a total Contract amount of one million, one
hundred ninety-eight thousand, eight hundred dollars ($1,198,800.00).
3.
Term of Agreement.This Agreement is effective when all parties have executed it
(Effective Date).The term of the Agreement is from the Effective Date through the
completion of the project.All services shall be completed during this term.However, the
parties agree that maintenance requirements described in Section6SubsectionE are
indefinite.
4.

A.
WYDOT will provide up to two hundred thousand dollars ($200,000.00)toward
project costs, as shown in Exhibit B-1, Revised Summary of Project Costs, which
is attached to and incorporated into this Agreement bythis reference.

E.
The City agrees to pay their portion of actual cost of this project, including all
indirect costs through the current Indirect Cost Allocation Plan (ICAP) rate as
approved by the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). ICAP is a rate built
intoWYDOT's accounting systemfor overhead expenditures for administering a
project.TheICAPrate is developed byWYDOT and approved by the FHWA, with
the new rate taking effect immediately. The current rate of eleven percent (11%) is
effective until September 30,2024, at whichtime the rate is subject to change based
on FHWA approval.The ICAPrate will be charged on total direct costs on this
project as shown on Exhibit B. WYDOT will bill the City on a monthly basis unless
otherwise agreed upon between the parties.
5.

costs incurred to the Project, less previous payments, within forty-five (45) days after
billing pursuant to Wyo.Stat. 16-6-602.
